source_claim: AlphaEvolve stores generated solutions with attached evaluation results and artifacts, so artifact evidence should be reusable through the evolutionary database
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can capture evaluator artifact metadata, artifact paths and hashes, redaction status, skipped-artifact diagnostics, stage/sample/attempt metadata, bounded content excerpts, runtime.history.artifact_index records, artifact-bearing current-run resurfacing sources, and artifact count/byte summaries. It does not claim durable artifact query tables, full artifact-content search, semantic artifact similarity search, cross-run artifact indexes, artifact-content ranking policy, or replayable artifact-driven sampling policy.
